mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows, and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC of the mechanism's signal vs. returns falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in the unemployment rate below 6% signals a strengthening labor market, boosting corporate profits and equity valuations, leading to positive 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in such triggered instances are not significantly higher than baseline (p > 0.05) or the unemployment rate does not drop below 6% in subsequent months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in quarterly GDP demand (GDPC1) and business demand (RSAFS) signal robust economic activity, driving up corporate earnings and equity valuations, resulting in positive 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and RSAFS both increase in the same quarter
failure_condition: Rank IC of the interaction signal vs. returns < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day returns are not significantly higher than baseline (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), a further rise in the federal funds rate signals heightened inflation expectations, compressing growth prospects and leading to negative 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly negative (p < 0.05) or the tightening cycle ends prematurely.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the supply index (INDPRO) indicates robust production capacity, reducing upward price pressure and fostering investor confidence, driving positive 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: Rank IC of the supply signal vs. returns < 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 60-day returns in supply expansions are not significantly higher than baseline (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDP demand (GDPC1) reflects strong economic growth, boosting corporate earnings and equity valuations, leading to positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window, or 20-day returns in growth periods are not significantly higher than baseline (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and rise in labor employment (PAYEMS) signal a tight labor market, boosting corporate profits and equity valuations, resulting in positive 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in such triggered instances are not significantly higher than baseline (p > 0.05) or the labor market conditions reverse.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle demand expansion, a decline in business demand (RSAFS) below 500 million signals overvaluation, leading to negative 20-day forward returns as investors adjust valuations downward.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in such triggered instances are not significantly negative (p < 0.05) or the demand expansion continues without RSAFS decline.
